ledger.note: c. 1290: the Ahis of Ankara declare semi-independence. 'Ahis in Ankara also saw their chance to declare their semi-independence under Mongol suzerainty' 'towards the end of the century (about 1290)'. The page gives the city, not a boundary, and the Ilkhanid suzerainty is the Ilkhanate's to record.

1354: Orhan annexes Ankara for a time. 'In 1354, Ankara was briefly annexed by Orhan of Ottoman Empire (then known as beylik).' The Orhan I page also has him take Ankara 'from the commercial-religious fraternity guild of Ahis' (undated). The page does not say how long the annexation lasted.

1362: Murad I ends the Ahis' political power. 'Although Ahis tried to restore their independence after Orhan's death, in 1362 Murad I ended the political power of Ahis' and 'they became the part of Ottoman Empire'. The Ottoman hold is no longer an occupation but annexation, recorded next.

notes:
Row identity: Cliopatria's 'Ahi Republic' (Wikipedia 'Ahis', Q400290) is the Ahi brotherhood of Ankara, a guild-republic 'often romantically referred to as an Ahi republic by modern historians'. Cliopatria's row covers 1305-1362 (two identical 16-cell shapes); the page begins it about 1290. The shape lies south-west of Ankara and leaves out the city itself, so a 25 km disc round Ankara is added in every verdict and in the events; the Ahi brotherhoods of other towns (Kırşehir, Kayseri, Konya, Denizli) appear on the page only as Ahi Evran's activities and are not territory.
Page budget (1-2 pages): Ahis (two questions) and Orhan I. No km2 on the page, so no ratio; the Cliopatria shape is 4,421 km2.
Not settled: how long the 1354 annexation lasted ('briefly') and when the Ahis regained Ankara (the page says only that they 'tried to restore their independence after Orhan's death'); the Mongol suzerainty (c. 1290, no end year) belongs in the ilkhanate dossier as a vassal relation (counterpart ahi-republic), which that dossier does not carry; the capital and any ruler (a brotherhood: no ruler list).
Cross-dossier: ottoman-empire has gain 1363 from ahi-republic (Cliopatria's year, page silent at confidence 1): the Ahis page dates the takeover to 1362 (this dossier), so that gain should read 1362 or 1363 with the Ahis page as source; ottoman-empire has no event for the 1354 occupation. germiyanids has a 1363 gain of the Ankara-Çankırı lobe from 'nobody' (confidence 1), which overlaps this land and its own reviewer asked to be checked; the Ahis page shows Ankara Ottoman from 1362.
